incidents.name: JAY token sell() reentrancy
incidents.notes: JAY.sell() sent ETH to the caller before burning the seller's JAY, so the attacker re-entered sell() from the ETH callback and drained the contract's ETH backing at a stale price.

sources.ref: onchain review: JAY 0xf2919d1d80aff2940274014bef534f7791906ff2 created 2022-07-18T23:47:59Z by 0xf58764c35ed1528ec78df18bebb24fa20f6a626f, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. 15.32 ETH x $1,195.35 at incidentTimestamp 1672290143 (DefiLlama) = $18,313.
